titulo_original: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother

sinopsis.es: El ganador del Oscar Mahershala Ali (Green Book) interpreta a un musulmán devoto, padre de familia entregado y sicario a sueldo en este thriller de acción audazmente inventivo ambientado en Texas, del guionista y director Bassam Tariq (Mogul Mowgli).
sinopsis.en: Oscar winner Mahershala Ali (TIFF ’18 People’s Choice Award winner Green Book) stars as a devout Muslim, loving family man, and contract killer in this audaciously inventive Texas-set action thriller from writer-director Bassam Tariq (Mogul Mowgli).
